title: First cohomology vanishes for finite constant sheaves restricted to principal opens of a quotient spectrum
statement: Let R be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with separably closed fraction field [def-pc-separably-closed], I an arbitrary ideal, M a finite abelian group, and h in R/I. If j : D(h) to Spec(R/I) is the open immersion, Sheaf.H of j-star of the constant abelian sheaf M [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] in degree one is a subsingleton.

source.place: Lemma 09ZC, proof third and fourth sentences, using 09ZB.

proof.text: Use gabber_principal_open_closed_presentation to obtain a closed immersion i from U = D(h) into Spec S, where S is a normal domain with separably closed fraction field. Install the returned instances.

Apply isZero_constant_cohomology_one_of_isIntegrallyClosed to S, U, i, M. Use the identity-scheme-isomorphism case of isZero_constant_cohomology_iff_subsingleton_H_of_iso to get Subsingleton of the Ext-defined first cohomology of the constant sheaf on U.

upperStarConstantSheafIso identifies the pullback of the constant sheaf on Spec(R/I) with the constant sheaf on U. Apply Sheaf.functorH.mapIso and convert the group isomorphism to an additive equivalence. Its injectivity transfers subsingletonness back to the restricted sheaf. The instance is passed explicitly because typeclass search does not unfold functorH.obj.
